method: All120 complete natural-ASR source/output pairs personally inspected, source-only fidelity/language/naturalness separated. No audio rehearing/independent blind review; references never model input. Three ambiguous edits remain null/uncertain rather than forced pass/fail. Corrupt sources copied faithfully are not automatically natural or usable. Strong suffix completions are not credited as new acoustic evidence.
